# TrackingMore

> > TrackingMore is the #1 multi-carrier tracking API platform integrating 1,569 global carriers with real-time shipment visibility and automation for eCommerce businesses.

TrackingMore provides a comprehensive tracking solution for eCommerce merchants and logistics providers, offering API integration, carrier support across all major carriers (UPS, USPS, FedEx, DHL), and automated customer notifications to reduce shipping inquiries (WISMO). The platform serves enterprises through flexible pricing plans and supports popular platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, and eBay.

## Key Topics

- Multi-carrier tracking
- Tracking API
- Package tracking
- Shipment visibility
- Real-time updates
- eCommerce integration
- Carrier detection
- Global shipping
- Webhook notifications
- SMS alerts
- API integration
- Logistics automation
- Parcel tracking
- Enterprise solutions
- Developer tools

- [Shipment Tracking API (USPS, UPS, FedEx, and DHL)](https://www.trackingmore.com/en/tracking-api): Multi-carrier tracking API documentation for USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL integration
